title: 題庫建置與持續擴充規格
qualityGates: 每題四個選項且只有一個正確答案（非選題需另訂評分規準）
答案與解析經人工或雙重規則檢查
標記課綱版本、年級、科目、單元與能力指標
歷屆考點衍生題需記錄考試名稱與年度，不複製受保護原文
避免跨年級重複題與只改數字的低品質重複題
每批執行重複題、答案索引、欄位完整性及語法檢查

integrationAuditNote:
2026-11-12 main branch audit found two issues: batch23 existed but was not loaded by the then-current index.html or sw.js, and index.html contained a literal tool-output truncation marker inside inline JavaScript causing a syntax error. Restored the last known syntactically valid UTF-8 index.html from commit 193134e95bc9caa682b349d14adf91562528d2b6, then re-added academic competition batch 04-07 script tags and question bank batch24 integration. Service Worker v34 lists question bank batches 08-24 and academic competition batches 01-07. Browser-level interaction testing remains unperformed. 2026-11-12 batch27 audit: immediately before integration, main contained original question-bank batches 08-26, index.html loaded and filtered batches 08-26, and Service Worker cache was v43 with academic competition assets 01-12. Added batch27 to index script loading and bankFor() filtering, and added its Service Worker asset while preserving academic batches 01-12 and existing image assets. Cache advanced to v44. Browser-level interaction testing and teacher review remain unperformed. 2026-11-13 batch28 audit: main baseline was batches08-27 (1,500 questions, 1,500 unique IDs), index.html loaded and filtered batches08-27, and Service Worker was v48 with academic competition batches01-14 and image assets. Added batch28 to index script loading and bankFor() filtering, advanced Service Worker to v49 and added its asset, while preserving all prior question banks and academic competition assets. Browser-level interaction testing and teacher review remain unperformed. Post-commit audit found b28-045 duplicated the normalized stem of b19-033; replaced it with a quadratic-vertex item and recorded the correction. Cross-batch exact-stem verification was repeated after the fix. A further item-quality pass refined distractors in selected questions and replaced one grade-5 sound item with a more age-appropriate vibration observation; count and IDs remain unchanged.
2026-11-13 batch29 audit: main baseline contained question-bank batches 08-28 (1,600 items, 1,600 unique IDs), index.html loaded and filtered batches08-28, and Service Worker was xy-learning-v49 with academic competition batches01-14. Added batch29 as window.EXTRA29_GRADE_BANK, integrated its script and pack29 filter in bankFor(), advanced Service Worker to v50 and added its asset, while preserving academic competition batches01-14 and existing image assets. Cross-batch normalized-stem comparison against batches08-28 found five exact matches in the first draft (b29-003, b29-015, b29-042, b29-043, b29-082); all five were rewritten and the comparisons rerun in three groups covering all 1,600 existing questions, with no remaining exact-stem or ID conflicts. Batch29 contains 100 questions, 20 for each active grade. Browser-level interaction testing and teacher review remain unperformed.

lastMainBranchAudit.note: 第30批新增100題，僅六年級50題與高二50題；其他年級題庫保留且本批不新增。第30批兩題在跨批次比對後改寫，修正後與第8至29批1,700題分組比對無完全相同正規化題幹。新分類推定器依題幹、單元與知識點標記學期、段考、依據、信心與出版社映射；無可靠依據者維持未分類。出版社對照僅限textbook-alignment.json列出的8筆官方來源映射，未核對的南一／其他單元標示共同核心或待核對。段考分類僅供複習建議，不是學校正式範圍。全庫仍保留兩組舊批次完全重複題幹（b9-006/b13-013、b13-020/b20-065），本次未刪改。
